question: At each causally visible exposure-increasing fill, can a side-specific sparse Boolean rule policy over the complete multiscale EMA-pair state choose the total add-cooldown duration that improves full-path terminal value relative to CONTROL_85N?

research_mapping.user_question: learn the cooldown duration from intersections and unions of multiscale EMA golden-cross, death-cross, ordering, magnitude, and persistence states
research_mapping.input_state: fill-time causal canonical-mid EMA surface, all legal fast/slow pairs, BUY and SELL side-signed separately
research_mapping.model_search_class: nested-chronological sparse Boolean rule lists with AND, OR, and NOT literals
research_mapping.output_action: one total cooldown-duration policy id chosen once when an exposure-increasing fill creates a cooldown-lineage revision
research_mapping.counterfactual_label: one complete-path Q^pi0(x,tau) fork for every legal opportunity and every side-specific candidate duration
research_mapping.full_path_test: current CONTROL_85N policy versus the frozen learned side policy, with all descendant orders, queue, fills, inventory, cooldown, and campaign state regenerated

authoritative_control.control_duration_semantics: 85 seconds times the same-side filled-quantity units after the target fill

fill_time_lineage_contract.exposure_classification_uses: inventory immediately before the target fill
fill_time_lineage_contract.policy_effect: block future same-side exposure-increasing add permission until the frozen deadline
fill_time_lineage_contract.same_side_active_orders_at_assignment: use the frozen baseline cancel-request, cancel-ACK, partial-fill, and terminal routing; no synthetic instantaneous removal
fill_time_lineage_contract.assignment_clock: fill visibility time; exchange time is retained as provenance but cannot make the policy visible earlier
fill_time_lineage_contract.feature_cutoff: every feature_ready_ts must be less than or equal to assignment visibility time
fill_time_lineage_contract.feature_snapshot: last canonical decision-visible local BBO mid generation available at assignment; no post-assignment BBO or future trade may enter
fill_time_lineage_contract.lineage_revision: each eligible exposure-increasing fill creates one immutable same-side cooldown-lineage revision and replaces the same-side deadline exactly once
fill_time_lineage_contract.later_exposure_fill: creates a new lineage revision under the same frozen policy
fill_time_lineage_contract.same_side_reducing_fill_with_zero_reduci: must not create a candidate duration and must not erase an already-active add cooldown
fill_time_lineage_contract.opposite_side_fill: clears the opposite side consecutive-unit counter and deadline according to the frozen control ABI
fill_time_lineage_contract.deadline_semantics: assignment_visible_ts plus the chosen total duration; fixed candidates are not multiplied by n
fill_time_lineage_contract.duration_expiry: restores permission only; it does not force an order submission

required_surface_state: all EMA levels relative to mid
curvature implied by the ordered EMA bank
ema_state_contract.cross_overlap_semantics: multiple cross predicates overlap while their ordering, age, persistence, and magnitude predicates remain true; simultaneous millisecond crossings are not required
ema_state_contract.unknown_or_unsupported_predicate: fail closed for the opportunity; do not impute a Boolean value

provider_2025.role: unsupervised EMA predicate construction and normalization only
provider_2025.sampling: all admitted provider-normalized 100ms BBO source rows with natural D-1 warmup

native_2026.role: all cooldown-duration full-path labels, nested chronological model discovery, outer OOF policy scoring, and every economic gate

outcome_blind_duration_artifact.duration_source: daily-fresh-start, day-equal-weighted Kaplan-Meier p25, p50, p75, and p90 of next inventory-state-change time and incremental-inventory undo time in the frozen current baseline
outcome_blind_duration_artifact.right_censoring: an unobserved next-state or undo event is right-censored at the natural UTC day end of its frozen daily-fresh-start Development path
outcome_blind_duration_artifact.rounding: nearest whole second for action serialization only

development_denominator.opportunity_definition: every legal exposure-increasing fill in the frozen 40-day native control path with valid fill identity, side, campaign, inventory-before, full causal EMA state, and positive CONTROL_85N duration
development_denominator.formal_label_panel_rule: the exact Cartesian product of every admitted opportunity and every candidate duration for that opportunity's side
development_denominator.missing_fork_policy: fail closed; do not train, score, or read a reduced complete-case panel

single_action_label_contract.estimand: Q^pi0_s(x_t,tau)=E[Y from target fill assignment to economic washout when only this target lineage duration is changed and all later decisions return to the frozen control policy]
full_path_components_required: cancel request and cancel ACK race
single_action_label_contract.data_boundary_without_washout: right_censored with contemporaneous mid and executable marks; no forced terminal and no arbitrary maximum duration

boolean_policy_search.clause_form: AND of positive or negated atomic predicates
boolean_policy_search.or_form: multiple clauses with the same duration consequence form a union
boolean_policy_search.not_form: a signed negative literal; post-hoc complement labels are forbidden
boolean_policy_search.allowed_consequences: the side-specific candidate policies in the outcome-blind duration artifact
boolean_policy_search.inner_selection_objective: maximize inner chronological OOF campaign-weighted chosen-duration terminal value minus CONTROL_85N value
boolean_policy_search.complexity_selection: one-standard-error rule; among statistically tied candidates choose fewer clauses, then fewer literals, then lexicographic serialized rule hash
boolean_policy_search.threshold_discovery_from_2026_economic_o: forbidden; atomic thresholds are frozen by the outcome-blind artifact

nested_chronological_development.outer_design: 16-day initial history followed by four non-overlapping six-day test folds
nested_chronological_development.outer_test_rows: all legal opportunities on the exact outer test-day union, never a sampled row set
nested_chronological_development.outer_label_end_purge: exclude every fit opportunity with any candidate fork right-censored or joint washout at or after the first assignment in the outer test fold
nested_chronological_development.inner_test_construction: within each outer fit-day candidate list, take the last nine ordered admissible days and split them into three consecutive non-overlapping three-day inner test blocks
nested_chronological_development.inner_train_construction: for each inner block use only earlier outer-fit days, apply a one-calendar-day embargo, and purge every label whose washout reaches the first inner assignment
nested_chronological_development.outer_test_use: execute the already selected inner rule-search procedure and score once; no threshold, rule, duration, or subgroup changes
nested_chronological_development.opportunity_weight_within_campaign: equal shares summing to one within each prospective campaign-side cluster

primary: day/campaign-clustered LCB95 of learned-policy terminal value minus CONTROL_85N is greater than zero
day/campaign-clustered LCB95 of learned-policy closed-campaign value minus CONTROL_85N is greater than zero
mechanics: every admitted opportunity has all eight side-specific forks
CONTROL_85N fork exactly reproduces the authoritative control path
second assignment before label washout equals zero
causal feature cutoff violations equal zero
campaign accounting error is at most 1e-6 USDC
model_support: every non-control clause meets the frozen day, campaign, and weight support
all selected literals and thresholds existed before outer outcomes
all four outer folds contain the chosen action or the side fails closed
development_gates.gate_failure: close only this exact Boolean duration-policy identity on Development; do not rewrite it as evidence for ADD-vs-WAIT, linear EMA, or all cooldown models

final_policy_identity_separation.label_identity: one target lineage duration override followed by CONTROL_85N continuation
final_policy_identity_separation.learned_policy_identity: apply the frozen rule list at every future legal exposure-increasing fill lineage revision
final_policy_identity_separation.policy_full_path_candidate: frozen side-specific Boolean duration rule on every eligible lineage, with the other side remaining CONTROL_85N unless it independently passes
final_policy_identity_separation.policy_assignment_and_attribution: carryover-safe campaign-side episode; no campaign may contribute to more than one independent policy assignment before economic washout

execution_and_confirmation_sequence: freeze this Spec, execution amendment, and outcome-blind inputs
freeze the complete 8600-opportunity native manifest without reading duration economics
implement and pass Python/C++ opportunity, duration, deadline, quote-permission, lifecycle, and terminal-path parity
materialize all 68800 single-action forks with checkpointed atomic admission
run nested chronological Development model discovery and outer OOF scoring separately for BUY and SELL
serialize one immutable side policy only for a side that passes every Development gate
run current-control versus learned-policy daily-fresh-start full-path Development screening
run restart-aware continuous confirmation with identical restart/gap schedules and continuous accounting
only after all prior stages pass may a separately frozen F09 action identity request Validation, holdout, canary, or live authority

daily_fresh_start_screening.purpose: historical Development screening and reproducible partitioned execution
daily_fresh_start_screening.UTC_midnight_behavior: fresh cash, inventory, campaign, orders, queue, cooldown, and EMA warmup state for each independent day

continuous_confirmation.ordinary_UTC_midnight: preserve each arm's cash, inventory, campaign, cooldown lineage, and cumulative accounting
continuous_confirmation.planned_gap_or_restart: both arms use one frozen restart manifest and the exact production restart-state contract; no arm-specific synthetic reset
continuous_confirmation.active_orders_at_restart: complete the shared cancel and terminal boundary contract before the offline interval
continuous_confirmation.final_panel_inventory: mark to contemporaneous executable and mid prices; never discard
continuous_confirmation.UTC_day_role: cluster and accounting partition only, not forced terminal
continuous_confirmation.non_Grade_A_gap_evidence: cannot grant exact queue or lifecycle authority near the gap

validation_and_holdout.read_requires: a successor execution amendment binding one immutable side-specific policy produced without Validation or holdout outcomes

hard_blockers_before_f09_or_live: complete 68800-fork label panel or explicit execution_blocker status
separately frozen F09 action and scorecard contract
forbidden_changes_after_freeze: dropping a candidate duration after seeing its value
adding a duration after seeing Development outcomes
changing the EMA price source or half-life bank
switching to a linear or pair-vote proxy
using 2025 provider PnL, queue, fill, or lifecycle labels
letting a reducing quote inherit the add cooldown
recomputing duration during an active lineage
reading Validation or holdout to rescue Development
using a Python-only or label-only result as F09 or live authority
